newsitem.title: USA: Centura to sell $100 mln capital securities.
newsitem.headline: Centura to sell $100 mln capital securities.

text.p: Centura Banks Inc is planning to raise $100 million in an offering of capital securities as early as this week via BT Securities Corp, according to an investment grade syndicate source.
The deal will be structured to include 30-year debt, non-callable for 10 years, the source said.
Centura Banks is a $6.4 billion North Carolina holding company that provides financial services through financial stores, supermarkets and automated teller machines.
Centura Banks did not immediately return a phone call.
